title: Quick Classic Gazpacho
description: This gazpacho with canned tomatoes, cucumber, and jalapeño is a fine substitute for any version made with fresh, vine-ripened tomatoes.
ingredients: 2 (14.5 ounce) cans diced tomatoes (I use Hunt's Petite Diced)
1 medium seedless cucumber, cut into 1/4-inch dice
1 small yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1/4-inch dice
1 small jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, basil or cilantro
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Pour 1/2 cup diced tomatoes into a food processor. Add water and oil to the food processor; blend until puréed. Pour into a medium bowl and add remaining diced tomatoes.
Stir in cucumber, bell pepper, onion, jalapeño, garlic, vinegar, and parsley; season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
